entries.title: Your computer is the first row of Settings on iPhone and iPad
entries.body: On your iPhone and iPad, Settings now starts with Your computer, which names the computer shown and whether it is in reach. It holds what the computer button showed: Leave, or Forget while out of reach, your other computers, Add another computer and Take over. The computer button and Command-I open it there, and while your computer is out of reach, tapping the line under the top bar opens it too.

picture.alt: The phone's Settings list with Your computer as its first row, reading Test Mac mini · Live, above General and Appearance
